attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell (CC BY 4.0) of BAG pand 0363100012171127 (CC0): the white Rembrandtplein front with its arcade, glazed winter garden, cast-iron balcony rails, hooded second-floor windows, central balcony, dentil cornice and the roof rail with the CAFE DE KROON board; the corner tower with its domed tourelle, balustraded balcony and arched windows; the Amstel front's arched stone base, read from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0). No pixels or meshes imported.
